integrity: The proof is analytical. Standalone finite computational tests are supplementary, not an infinite-dimensional certificate; independent verification has not been undertaken.
limitations: The result covers compact full-dimensional Euclidean polytopes of dimension at least four, invariant affine-line sampling, and the first near-diameter term. It does not cover other chord conventions or provide a full length distribution, and historical priority against less-indexed integral-geometric literature remains provisional.
title: A universal tangent-cone factorization for near-diameter chords of convex polytopes
